name: The Settlers' League hall
verdict: A charming, compact banner shop where the cyan-and-white striped awning, the hanging banners and the flagpole read clearly as a flag seller, but the grey stone-brick walls and roof merge into one monotone lump, and loose bits (protruding corner-post stumps, a stray cobble block and lantern at the back, a cluttered upper front) keep it below use-as-is.

log.verdict: The ground-floor flag stall reads clearly and has charm: the striped awning, the row of banners, the counter and the barrels all work. Above it the building falls apart. The stepped stone-brick roof is a heavy grey lump with no overhang, the upper front is a confused recess of stone stairs where the meeting room should be, and the floating pole banner and lone corner posts make it look unfinished.

log.n: task 1: Pattern the front banners properly
task 2: Fix hanging-banner/lantern clash on the
task 3: Make the sign legible and prominent
task 5: Stepped stone peak above the gable
task 6: Interior stock and meeting room
task 8: Plank/wool lean-to on the back (have-not
task 9: Vines and extra weathering at the base
